card.name: Linking words before bedtime or age ranges
card.fires_on: Small linking words (before, at, to, of) or a gap before a time or age limit, such as bedtime, night, an age in years, or minutes after dosing. It fires where the next word is likely bed, bedtime, night, or a number.
